title: Web - Browser LCP p75 above target by surface

model.expr: quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name="tuist-web"} | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="prod" | lcp!="" | __error__="" | context_rum_schema="1" | context_rum_quality="eligible" | unwrap lcp | __error__="" [6h]) by (app_environment, context_rum_surface) / 1000

sum by (app_environment, context_rum_surface) (count_over_time({service_name="tuist-web"} | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="prod" | lcp!="" | __error__="" | context_rum_schema="1" | context_rum_quality="eligible" [6h]))

count by (app_environment, context_rum_surface) (sum by (app_environment, context_rum_surface, session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="tuist-web"} | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="prod" | lcp!="" | __error__="" | context_rum_schema="1" | context_rum_quality="eligible" [6h])))

annotations.description: Six-hour operational measurement, not a CrUX assessment. Eligible means complete metadata and a non-negative numeric LCP, not verified human. Includes unknown automation. B is LCP samples; D is distinct browser-reported sessions. The sample/session floors are provisional and must be calibrated per surface before enabling. Inspect raw percentiles, quality, navigation timing and Cloudflare correlation before changing filtering.

sum by (app_environment) (count_over_time({service_name="tuist-web"} | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="prod" | lcp!="" | __error__="" [6h]))

annotations.summary: More than 5% of LCP samples lack gateway context
annotations.description: Six-hour fraction of all prod LCP samples missing schema 1. Includes legacy/bypass ingestion, not just enriched samples. Expected during rollout or rollback; keep paused until the cutover window clears.

annotations.description: Compare counts by context_rum_quality. Measurements remain in the raw stream. A passing eligible-only percentile must not hide missing session/navigation IDs, unknown routes or invalid values. Threshold is provisional.

annotations.summary: More than 10% of enriched LCP samples lack a trusted collector Ray ID
annotations.description: Check the Cloudflare/ingress trust chain. The Ray ID identifies the collector POST, not the document navigation. An absent Ray ID is unknown evidence, not automation. Threshold is provisional; applies only to prod behind Cloudflare.

annotations.summary: {{ $labels.context_rum_surface }} LCP samples come from fewer than 50 sessions
annotations.description: The p75 performance rule is gated on at least 50 reported sessions. Investigate a concentrated cohort instead of interpreting the gated percentile as healthy. Session IDs are browser-reported, not a Sybil-resistant human count. No navigation deduplication is applied. Floor is provisional.

title: Web - Browser RUM enriched LCP missing

model.expr: (sum by (app_environment) (count_over_time({service_name="tuist-web"} | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="prod" | lcp!="" | __error__="" | context_rum_schema="1" [2h]))) or vector(0)

annotations.summary: No enriched production LCP samples for two hours
annotations.description: Checks pipeline liveness independently of percentile eligibility. Keep the existing raw-ingestion missing-data alert too. Only enable after gateway rollout. Healthy low-volume surfaces may be absent from the per-surface rules.
